items.title: Operational Planning and Control
items.summary: Addresses planning and controlling ISMS processes to meet security objectives and manage changes.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Addresses planning and controlling ISMS processes to meet security objectives and manage changes. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for operational planning and control are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Operational Planning and Control
examples.context: A team must address operational planning and control in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Operational Planning and Control
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to operational planning and control.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
